text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Welcome to the Levincia Gym,\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)].

text: Are you ready to challenge Gym Leader Iono,\nthe Supercharged Streamer?

text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]How’re ya feelin’ about this battle,\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]?[VAR 0x0114(0019)]

label: gym_denki_040_select_01

label: gym_denki_040_select_02
text: Like I can’t lose!

label: gym_denki_040_select_03
text: I’m honestly a little worried...

label: gym_denki_040_denki_04a
text: Boom! We got a straight talker here, ’eyyy?\nNo nonsense! I like it![VAR 0x0114(0019)]

label: gym_denki_040_denki_04b
text: Hey heyyy! We got a lively one here! You’d make\na gnarly influencer, friendo![VAR 0x0114(0019)]

label: gym_denki_040_denki_04c
text: Oh ho hooo? Playing timid, eh? Nyahaha! I don’t\nhate it![VAR 0x0114(0019)]

label: gym_denki_040_denki_05
text: All righty, then! Who’s ready to see me kick\nsome butt?[VAR 0x0114(0019)]

label: gym_denki_040_comment_02

label: gym_denki_040_comment_03
text: >Battle! Battle!

label: gym_denki_040_comment_04

label: gym_denki_040_denki_07
text: Let’s get this show on the road! How strong is\nour challenger? I ’unno! Let’s find out together![VAR 0x0114(0019)]

label: gym_denki_040_denki_08
text: Our challenger came out victorious! Well done,\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(0019)]

label: gym_denki_040_comment_05
text: >Whoa!

label: gym_denki_040_comment_06
text: >IONO!!!

label: gym_denki_040_comment_07

label: gym_denki_040_denki_09
text: I hate to say it, but I lost! Thanks for cheerin’ me\non anywho, my loyal fans![VAR 0x0114(0019)]

label: gym_denki_040_denki_10
text: Well then! What does our challenger get for\nbeating me—the lean, mean streamin’ queen?\r\nI’ll tell ya! [VAR 0x0100(0000)], you win...[VAR 0x0114(0019)]

text: By the bysies, with [VAR 0x0200(0001)] Gym Badge[VAR 0x1101(0001,0100)]s, Poké pals of\nup to Lv. [VAR 0x0201(0002)] will be easier to catch! They’ll listen\r\nto ya when you ask ’em to do stuff, too![VAR 0x0114(0019)]

label: gym_denki_040_denki_badge_all
text: By the bysies, with all 8 Gym Badges, you can\ncatch Poké pals of any level, and they’ll ALL\r\nlisten to ya when you ask ’em to do stuff![VAR 0x0114(0019)]

text: And as my thanks for such a sweet pic, I’mma\ngive you a Tee Em![VAR 0x0114(0019)]

text: If any of you found our electrifying battle to be—\nbzzzt!—shocking, go smash that subscribe button![VAR 0x0114(0019)]
